name: issue_653_inherited_constraint_index_name
description: Dump replay failed or silently dropped an index when a partition's inherited PRIMARY KEY index name collided with a standalone index
notes: PARTITION OF copies the parent's PRIMARY KEY and UNIQUE constraints onto the partition under generated names; with a standalone index already named events_leaf_pkey, the copy is named events_leaf_pkey1.

Creating the partition with the constraint inline, before the standalone index, gave the generated name to the copy. The later CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_leaf_pkey was skipped and ALTER INDEX ... ATTACH PARTITION failed with SQLSTATE 42809.

The dump now follows pg_dump: PRIMARY KEY and UNIQUE constraints of a partitioned table with partitions are added after the tables with ALTER TABLE ONLY, each partition copy under its catalog name, followed by ALTER INDEX ... ATTACH PARTITION.
